all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
Psalm 23:4
Quote of the Day
"Strength comes as we walk with Christ and hold fast to His eternal truths."
President Emily Belle Freeman | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
